instruction_covers: every positive delta (advance or update completed=) feeding one rate estimate over the sampling window
zero/negative deltas update completed but add no rate evidence
Task.speed = completed / elapsed between retained samples
Task.time_remaining uses the rate and ceils remaining work, None when no estimate
reaching finite total via update sets finished/finished_time/finished_speed, later updates don't change them
reset clears rate evidence, retains total, allows fresh estimate
changing total via update invalidates rate evidence
backwards compatibility of fields/rendering and total=None behavior
reason: All tested behaviors (speed from deltas, non-positive deltas ignored, ceil'd time_remaining, frozen finished_time/finished_speed, reset and total-change invalidation) are explicitly described in the instruction; names like speed, time_remaining, finished_speed and the reset/update signatures are pre-existing public API of rich's Task/Progress, so nothing unstated remains.
